deterministic_evidence: V2_EVAL_REPORT.md Verification notes P1: only RPE1 holds raw counts; tokenisation rank correlation with intended order 0.85 (K562) / 0.76 (Adamson); on single-log data K562 keeps 19 of 174 perturbations
notes: Variance still beats attention after the fix; model inputs need re-extraction to be fully correct.

short_name: scGPT cross-model comparison used the wrong embedding rows
deterministic_evidence: V2_CROSSMODEL_REPORT.md Verification notes: under the deployed rule 0 of 382/350/380 panel genes got their own scGPT row; with the checkpoint vocab.json rows, scGPT CCA = 0.730/0.741/0.730 vs Geneformer 0.794/0.778/0.769; deployed 0.411/0.437/0.399 is at chance (0.410/0.430/0.412)
notes: The cross-architecture scope claim (alignment breaks across families) rests on this bug.

short_name: Residualisation fitted in float32, not a least-squares fit
deterministic_evidence: V2_EVAL_REPORT.md Verification notes: float64 residualised AUROC 0.492/0.492/0.534/0.510 vs deployed 0.487/0.492/0.520/0.543; 1B keeps ~18% of above-chance signal, not 78%

short_name: Beating the degree-preserving null is not model-specific (co-expression also beats it)
deterministic_evidence: V2_EVAL_REPORT.md Verification notes P2: plain co-expression from the same control cells gets z=+3.09 (RPE1) and +2.20 (1B) against the same null; a two-gene-mean score gets z=+1.81 in RPE1, equal to layer-8 attention

short_name: Manifold trustworthiness depends on the number of anchors scored
where_it_lives: runs/manifold-discovery-217M gate comparisons across panels of different size (lung control 50 anchors vs internal 290 / external 600)
deterministic_evidence: V2_INTERVALS_AND_FACTS_REPORT.md Verification notes: deployed head on random 50-anchor subsets gives 0.750 (internal), 0.776 (zero-shot), 0.804 (external); trust correlates 0.72 with training-set size; the lung control 0.7996 is typical for 50 anchors
notes: Cross-panel trust comparisons and the lung-control fail are not interpretable without size matching.
